local.sourceErasure: Synthetic authoritative disclosure/restore path. Deleting a private source and linked care record produced separate independent intents. A legacy tombstone without proof blocked restore. Bounded backfill supplied the original deletion proof; after restore to a fresh epoch, deleted source text, management history and exports stayed unavailable while a separate valid source remained readable.
local.report: Focused checkpoint test covered 105 dated records across three batches, Hong Kong midnight, old checkpoints without period counts, annual / quarterly / custom dates and a one-day living report. Counts use all scanned pages and are independent of the selected wording limit. Server typecheck passed.
local.projection: Code review traced snapshot ID and version to the Web and Android Report data disclosure and to the PDF renderer. No production family report was opened.
